sentences.text: With under two weeks until the October 27 election, Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party launched its campaign aiming to draw votes from the opposition bloc and overtake Likud.

sources.title: Eisenkot's Yashar launches campaign aiming to draw votes from opposition bloc, overtake Likud

sentences.text: Shas leader Arye Deri announced that there will be no government in Israel with his party's support or participation unless the status of yeshiva students is regulated.

sources.title: Deri demands haredi draft law as condition for next government

sentences.text: Candidate Davidi Ben Zion quit Ofer Winter's People of Israel party amid pressure from Likud and Bezalel Smotrich, who are urging smaller right-wing factions to withdraw from the race.

sources.title: People of Israel candidate quits Ofer Winter's party amid mounting pressure from right-wing rivals
Likud, Smotrich pressure smaller parties to quit election race; signs placed outside candidate’s home

sentences.text: Ben-Gvir also refused to sign a surplus vote sharing agreement with People of Israel, calling Winter Bennett II.

sources.title: 'Bennett II': Ben-Gvir refuses to sign vote surplus share agreement with Winter's People of Israel

sentences.text: According to the Jerusalem Post, both Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc and Eisenkot's opposition camp are struggling to secure a governing majority.

sources.title: Netanyahu, Eisenkot blocs struggle to secure majority, raising fears of another election deadlock

sentences.text: Former Shin Bet chief Ronen Bar filed a defamation suit against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over prewar warnings, prompting opposition leaders to demand a state inquiry and Netanyahu's resignation.

sources.title: Opposition slams Netanyahu over Oct. 7 after ex-Shin Bet chief's libel suit
Ex-Shin Bet chief files defamation suit against Netanyahu, lists warnings given prior to Oct. 7

sentences.text: Netanyahu responded by asking why Bar had not called him before the attack, while also telling Army Radio that there are signs adversaries may attempt an attack before the election.

sources.title: Netanyahu responds to Ronen Bar's libel suit, says ex-Shin Bet chief could have called him on Oct. 7
Netanyahu repeats claim Israel's enemies seeking to attack before election
